_what: Where files sent with a message from the composer (tools/ui/show/composer) are kept in the person's Files, read by src/workspace/send-message.ts. Each message's files go in a folder of their own beneath `folder`, named by the moment it was sent, so two pictures both called image.png never meet. A message to the AIs is kept on this device until its seed row is written (send-to-seeds.json names the row and its route). `kept` is what the person is told when the account could not be reached and the outbox is sending it again.
kept: Waiting to send. This device has it and will send it as soon as your account answers.
